entries.zh: 诉告；在讼案中起诉告状
entries.en: to appeal in a lawsuit; to sue and lodge a complaint

entries.zh: 诉冤枉；因受冤屈而鸣冤申诉〔第二字[疑]冤/觅〕
entries.en: to appeal against injustice; to protest a wrongful charge, cry out one's grievance
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:冤/覓]，据官话对音 iuĕn 判为「冤」，据此定释义

entries.zh: 诉明；向官府陈明辩白、申诉表白清楚
entries.en: to state one's case and clear oneself before the court

entries.zh: 诉状；呈递状纸申诉（以诉状告理）
entries.en: a written complaint, bill of petition; to sue by written petition

entries.zh: 诉词；讼词、申诉的状词文词
entries.en: words of complaint; the pleading text of a suit
entries.notes: 西语尾部 con diminos monta 残讹（似 con dineros monta），未据以定释义，以汉字「诉词」为准

entries.zh: 分诉；分辩申诉、自行辩白
entries.en: to plead one's defense; to argue and excuse oneself
entries.notes: 西语词头 aîropech 残讹不可辨，据汉字「分诉」与闽南语对音释义

entries.zh: 上司；上级长官（向上司申诉、越级呈告）
entries.en: one's superior; to appeal to one's superior

entries.zh: 上司告状；向上司呈状告理
entries.en: to lodge a complaint or suit with one's superior

entries.zh: 上司诉状；呈递上司的申诉状纸
entries.en: a written appeal to a superior; bill of complaint before one's superior

entries.zh: 防；防备、提防、戒备
entries.en: to guard against; to be on one's guard, take precautions

entries.zh: 防备；预先戒备、有所准备
entries.en: to be prepared, take precautions; to be on guard against

entries.zh: 防御；抵御、防护（御敌）
entries.en: to defend against, ward off, resist

entries.zh: 防守；守卫、看守防备
entries.en: to guard, defend, keep watch

entries.zh: 防身；护身自卫
entries.en: to defend oneself; self-protection
entries.notes: 西语词头 apercelir 词形非标准（疑为 apercibir 之形讹），据汉字「防身」释义

entries.zh: 关防；设防戒备、严密防守〔首字[疑]开/关〕
entries.en: to secure one's defenses, keep close guard (first character uncertain: 開/關, likely 關)
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:開/關]，据 M/R 对音 cuān 与西语 aprestarse（整装备战）取「關防」义，「開防」存备一说

entries.zh: 固守；坚守（阵地以御敌）
entries.en: to hold firm in defense, fortify oneself against the enemy

entries.zh: 按；按压、按下
entries.en: to press down, hold down

entries.zh: 按落去；往下按、压下去
entries.en: to press down, push down; to weigh down
entries.notes: 西语 gvtar 疑为 apretar 之形讹，据汉字「按落去」释义

entries.zh: 按带；向下按压所负之物〔「按带」字面组合罕见，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to press down upon what is carried; to bear down a load
entries.notes: 「按带」搭配罕见且西语 apexar ḡ este cargado 残讹，释义据官话 àn dài 与西语语境推拟

entries.zh: 号；别号、称号（人之称呼别名）
entries.en: appellation; to call by name (headword truncated: apellido or apellidar)
entries.notes: 词头截断 Apellid.，apellido/apellidar 未定；据汉字「號」释义为称号、别号

entries.zh: 臨臨；将近、几乎、差一点
entries.en: barely, scarcely; almost, near to
entries.notes: 官话栏含未明旁注 (mantuch.)；叠字「臨臨」据西语 apenas/casi/cerca 释义为将近、几乎

entries.zh: 慾；欲望、嗜欲（心愿所求）
entries.en: appetite; affection, desire, wish

entries.zh: 慾心动；心生欲念、欲念萌动
entries.en: desire stirred in the heart; appetite and inclination toward something
